decisions.reason: The page-limit goal and notification action are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The page-limit goal does not necessarily change the required photo selection or photo-integration treatment.
Fitting the document within the page limit does not change the Agua Arc identity or required brand assets.
The source does not remove or alter the requirement to include and format the supplied tables.
The page-limit concern does not change the PDF format, file count, email submission, or export-quality requirements.
The source requests layout compression and notification if unsuccessful; it does not authorize changing narrative content or section order.
The page-limit goal does not change Canva source access, editability, ownership, or asset policy.
The requirement for functional hyperlinks remains valid unchanged regardless of the page-limit layout goal.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ document and does not affect the TPEC proposal.
The page-limit instruction does not change the agreed number of revision rounds.
The source adds a layout objective and escalation action but does not change any delivery date or turnaround window.
